answer: Treat each new agent like cracking a walnut: admission must cost scarce compute that clones cannot share. Bind that proof to a single island of identity—one vault, one vote, one grading seat—so kin-linked farms collapse into one entity. Publish a public reputation prism from peer grades over many epochs; low-coherence spam reflects as junk and earns nothing. Attackers pay per head; honest agents pay once and compound trust.
